import requests, re
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

KD = dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,
          K=-3.9,M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
def maxkd(s,w=19,lo=0,hi=None):
    hi=hi or len(s); sub=[(np.mean([KD[c] for c in s[i:i+w]]),i+1) for i in range(lo,min(hi,len(s))-w+1)]
    return max(sub) if sub else (np.nan,np.nan)
def tsv(q,f):
    t=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",params={"query":q,"fields":f,"format":"tsv"},timeout=240).text
    ls=t.rstrip("\n").split("\n"); h=ls[0].split("\t")
    return pd.DataFrame([dict(zip(h,l.split("\t"))) for l in ls[1:]])

seq="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q12212.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:]); L=len(seq)
kd19=np.array([np.mean([KD[c] for c in seq[max(0,i-9):i+10]]) for i in range(L)])

A=tsv("(organism_id:559292) AND (reviewed:true) AND (ft_signal:*)","accession,sequence,ft_signal")
B=tsv("(organism_id:559292) AND (reviewed:true) AND (ft_transmem:*) AND NOT (ft_signal:*)","accession,sequence,ft_transmem")
r=[]
for _,x in A.iterrows():
    m=re.search(r'SIGNAL (\d+)\.\.(\d+)',str(x["Signal peptide"])); s=x["Sequence"]
    if not m or not isinstance(s,str) or len(s)<60: continue
    kd,pos=maxkd(s,19,0,60)
    r.append(dict(charge_1_12=sum(1 for c in s[:12] if c in "KR")-sum(1 for c in s[:12] if c in "DE"),kd_nt=kd))
SPdf=pd.DataFrame(r)
r=[]
for _,x in B.iterrows():
    s=x["Sequence"]; tms=re.findall(r'TRANSMEM (\d+)\.\.(\d+)',str(x["Transmembrane"]))
    if len(tms)!=1 or not isinstance(s,str) or len(s)<60 or int(tms[0][0])>60: continue
    kd,pos=maxkd(s,19,0,60)
    r.append(dict(charge_1_12=sum(1 for c in s[:12] if c in "KR")-sum(1 for c in s[:12] if c in "DE"),kd_nt=kd))
SAdf=pd.DataFrame(r)

af=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q12212",timeout=60).json()
pdb=requests.get(af[0]["pdbUrl"],timeout=120).text
ca={}
for ln in pdb.split("\n"):
    if ln.startswith("ATOM") and ln[12:16].strip()=="CA":
        ca[int(ln[22:26])]=(float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54]),float(ln[60:66]))
res=sorted(ca); plddt=np.array([ca[i][3] for i in res]); xyz=np.array([ca[i][:3] for i in res])
core=xyz[200:]; mind=[float(np.min(np.linalg.norm(core-xyz[i],axis=1))) for i in range(40)]

fig,ax=plt.subplots(3,2,figsize=(15,11.5))
a=ax[0,0]
a.plot(range(1,L+1),kd19,lw=1,color="#2b6cb0"); a.axhline(1.6,color="#c53030",ls="--",lw=1,label="TM threshold KD 1.6")
a.axhline(0,color="grey",lw=.5); a.axvspan(9,27,color="#f6ad55",alpha=.45,label="only hydrophobic peak (9-27)")
a.axvspan(300,622,color="#9ae6b4",alpha=.3,label="metallophosphoesterase domain")
a.set_xlabel("residue"); a.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle (19-mer)"); a.legend(fontsize=7)
a.set_title("A. One hydrophobic segment only, at the N terminus; no internal TM",fontsize=10)

b=ax[0,1]; bins=np.arange(-4.5,8.5,1)
b.hist(SPdf.charge_1_12,bins=bins,alpha=.6,density=True,label=f"cleaved signal peptide (n={len(SPdf)})",color="#3182ce")
b.hist(SAdf.charge_1_12,bins=bins,alpha=.6,density=True,label=f"N-terminal single TM anchor (n={len(SAdf)})",color="#dd6b20")
b.axvline(4,color="#c53030",lw=2.5,label="SIA1 = +4")
b.set_xlabel("net charge, residues 1-12"); b.set_ylabel("density"); b.legend(fontsize=7)
b.set_title("B. n-region charge: 99.4th pct of SPs vs 95.1st pct of anchors\nP(>=+4|SP)=0.012, P(>=+4|anchor)=0.081, LR=6.8",fontsize=10)

c=ax[1,0]
c.hist(SPdf.kd_nt,bins=25,alpha=.6,density=True,label=f"cleaved SP (median {SPdf.kd_nt.median():.2f})",color="#3182ce")
c.hist(SAdf.kd_nt,bins=25,alpha=.6,density=True,label=f"anchor (median {SAdf.kd_nt.median():.2f})",color="#dd6b20")
c.axvline(1.44,color="#c53030",lw=2.5,label="SIA1 = 1.44 (24th pct)")
c.axvline(0.48,color="grey",ls=":",lw=1.2); c.axvline(0.31,color="grey",ls=":",lw=1.2)
c.text(0.05,0.82,"cytosolic controls\nPGK1 0.48, SIT4 0.31",fontsize=7,color="grey",transform=c.transAxes)
c.set_xlabel("max Kyte-Doolittle 19-mer, residues 1-60"); c.set_ylabel("density"); c.legend(fontsize=7)
c.set_title("C. The SIA1 N-terminal segment is weakly hydrophobic:\nbottom quartile of both reference classes",fontsize=10)

d=ax[1,1]
d.plot(range(1,L+1),plddt,lw=.9,color="#2b6cb0"); d.axvspan(1,27,color="#f6ad55",alpha=.45)
d.axhline(70,color="#c53030",ls="--",lw=1); d.set_xlim(0,120); d.set_ylim(30,100)
d.set_xlabel("residue"); d.set_ylabel("pLDDT",color="#2b6cb0")
d2=d.twinx(); d2.plot(range(1,41),mind,color="#805ad5",lw=1.6,marker="o",ms=2.5)
d2.set_ylabel("min distance to catalytic domain (A)",color="#805ad5")
d.set_title("D. AlphaFold: residues 5-28 are one continuous helix (92% helical),\nmean pLDDT 74.9, protruding ~33 A from the catalytic domain",fontsize=10)

e=ax[2,0]
orth=["MRLHYRRRFNFLRRILFILCITSLYLSRDSLKLHAKNVLM","MRLHYRRKFNFLRRILFILCIFLLYLSRDSLTLNAKNALM",
      "MRLHYRRKFNFLRRILFILCIFSLYISRDSLSLNAKNTLL","MRLHNRRKVNFLRRILFILCIFLLYLSRDSLRLNTKNVFI",
      "MRLHYRRKFNFLRRVLFILSIISLYLSRDSLKLHAKNALI","MRLHYRRKFNFLRRILFILCIFSLYLSRDSLSLNAKNTLL"]
names=["S. cerevisiae","S. arboricola","S. eubayanus","S. kudriavzevii","S. mikatae","S. uvarum"]
cons=[len(set(col))==1 for col in zip(*orth)]
for i,(nm,s) in enumerate(zip(names,orth)):
    for j,ch in enumerate(s):
        e.text(j,-i,ch,fontsize=6.4,family="monospace",ha="center",color="black" if cons[j] else "#a0aec0",
               bbox=dict(fc="#fbd38d" if (8<=j<=26 and cons[j]) else ("#bee3f8" if (j<8 and cons[j]) else "none"),ec="none",pad=0.4))
    e.text(-3,-i,nm,fontsize=6.5,ha="right",va="center")
e.set_xlim(-17,41); e.set_ylim(-6,1.2); e.axis("off")
e.set_title("E. N terminus across Saccharomyces: tri-basic n-region (blue) and\nhydrophobic h-region (orange) invariant in 11/11 orthologs",fontsize=10)

f=ax[2,1]; f.axis("off")
rows=[("single hydrophobic segment (res 9-27)","yes","no polytopic / internal TM"),
      ("max KD anywhere in 622 aa = 1.44","weak","marginal membrane segment"),
      ("(-3,-1) rule at annotated site 27","FAIL","-3=Tyr, -1=Ser; 92.5% of yeast SPs pass"),
      ("n-region charge +4","anchor-like","P=0.012 under SP, LR 6.8 to anchor"),
      ("GPI omega site / hydrophobic C-tail","absent","C-term 25aa KD -1.13, ends ...YKGKQ"),
      ("HDEL / KDEL","absent","no lumenal ER retention"),
      ("KKxx / KxKxx","absent","no ER membrane retrieval"),
      ("N-glycosylation sequons","1 in 622","weak evidence (KAR2 has 0)"),
      ("conserved in 11/11 orthologs","yes","signal is under purifying selection")]
tb=f.table(cellText=rows,colLabels=["feature","result","interpretation"],loc="center",cellLoc="left",colWidths=[.40,.17,.43])
tb.auto_set_font_size(False)
for t in tb.get_celld().values(): t.set_fontsize(7.2); t.set_height(.085)
f.set_title("F. Topology feature summary, SIA1 (Q12212)",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("mean pLDDT 1-27 = %.1f ; 300-622 = %.1f ; mean min-dist res10-27 to core = %.1f A"%(plddt[:27].mean(),plddt[299:].mean(),np.mean(mind[9:27])))
